data.name: Unblinking Flame Fist
data.description: You can exploit the weaknesses in your opponents' defenses, like a flame seeking fuel to consume. When using Perfect Style, the save DC of your stunning fist attack increases by 2 against flat-footed targets. When you spend 1 ki point to gain the benefits of Improved Feint for 1 round, you may attempt a feint as part of your movement when charging.
prerequisites: PREABILITY:4,CATEGORY=FEAT,Perfect Style,Combat Expertise,Stunning Fist,Unblinking Flame Feint
PRETEXT:Prerequisites: Int 13, Wis 13, Combat Expertise, Perfect Style, Stunning Fist, Unblinking Flame Feint, base attack bonus +13 or monk level 13th.
